# WhatsApp Number Checker API

> Check WhatsApp registration for one phone number or up to 100 numbers synchronously.

Official landing page: https://walookup.com/products/ws
Documentation: https://walookup.com/api-docs
API base: https://walookup.com
Authentication: X-API-Key
Products: ws
Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, JavaScript, Shell
Pricing: https://walookup.com/pricing

Use JSON `POST /api/v1/check` for one E.164 phone number or `POST /api/v1/batch-check` for 1–100 numbers. Both use `service_type=ws`. Batch results preserve input order; `exists=false` is undetermined and `registered` is then absent. Limits: 200 submitted numbers per UTC minute, 5 concurrent checks, one batch at a time. `GET /api/v1/balance` returns `balance_micros`. Server examples read `WALOOKUP_API_KEY`.
